acceptedAnswer.text: Proveedores concretos, estándares concretos. Café La Cabra de Copenhague, masa madre Origo de Barcelona, bagels Bagel Boy de Barcelona, salmón Benfumat de Cataluña. acceptedAnswer.text: The option we know with genuine organic masala chai on the central Costa Brava is Dirty Rabbit in S'Agaró — between Sant Feliu de Guíxols and Platja d'Aro. Avinguda Platja d'Aro 275.

mainEntity.name: What chai versions do you have and how much do they cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three versions: classic chai latte (hot or iced), iced chai year-round, and dirty chai with a shot of La Cabra espresso. €3.50 to €5. Plant milk available in all versions.

mainEntity.name: Do you have iced chai outside summer on the Costa Brava?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most places don't. At Dirty Rabbit, yes — year-round. The Costa Brava has mild autumns and winters, and some people prefer chai cold regardless of season.

mainEntity.name: Does masala chai have caffeine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The black tea base in masala chai contains roughly 25–50 mg of caffeine per serving, depending on steep time. That's less than a shot of espresso (60–70 mg). Dirty chai adds an espresso shot — that's the highest-caffeine version of the three.

mainEntity.name: Do you have dairy-free options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Plant milk is available in all chai versions — oat, soy, and coconut. The full menu has options for people who don't drink dairy.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between chai latte and masala chai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Masala chai is the original Indian drink: black tea steeped with whole spices (cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, clove, black pepper), usually simmered with milk. A chai latte is the Western café version — the same spiced tea base, steamed with milk. At Dirty Rabbit, both terms refer to the same thing: Awachai's organic spice blend, steeped with black tea, finished with steamed milk.

mainEntity.name: Can I get oat milk chai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We have oat milk, soy milk, and coconut milk. Oat milk works particularly well with chai — the fat content carries the spice notes better than thinner plant milks. Just mention your preference when you order.

mainEntity.name: What's the best chai for someone who doesn't like coffee?

acceptedAnswer.text: The classic chai latte or the iced chai. Both are completely coffee-free. Masala chai has its own caffeine from the black tea base, but no espresso. If you want something warming and spiced with zero coffee involvement, start with the hot chai latte.

mainEntity.name: Where does Awachai source its spices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Awachai is based in Isère, France. They source certified organic spices — cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, clove, and black pepper — and blend them into a loose spice mix (not a concentrate or syrup). The blend is steeped with black tea as part of preparation.

copy-23b850e71c68.value: Bikini Super Classic — 6€. Porc 100% Duroc amb Havarti fos entre pa de massa mare. És el que demanes quan vols alguna cosa contundent i de veritat sense complicar-te. Tenim gent que torna específicament per aquest.

copy-8640b782a829.value: Mr. Croissant — 6€. York i Havarti en croissant. Clàssic, segur, sense complicacions. No cal disculpar-se per això.

copy-6114bb98b2de.value: Cherries Lady — 7,90€. Formatge crema, tomàquet cherry, ceba tendra cruixent. Més lleuger. Funciona bé si el demanes juntament amb un cafè en lloc de com a plat únic.

          southern Costa Brava. The café is known first for coffee, with a La Marzocco KB90 behind
          the bar, but the same logic that shaped the coffee menu shaped the matcha menu too:
          choose suppliers with a name, a point of view, and a product worth explaining.

copy-4f2105e2bb37.value:
This matters on the Costa Brava because many cafés run under intense seasonal pressure.
          From June to September, service gets faster, queues get longer, and menus often drift
          toward whatever is easiest to execute. Matcha has become fashionable, but good matcha is
          still rare. Dirty Rabbit opened with the idea that quality should not disappear just
          because the beach is full. The shop stays open year-round, and the matcha program stays on
          the menu through winter, shoulder season, and summer rush alike.

# Dirty Rabbit

> Specialty coffee shop in S'Agaró, Costa Brava. Open since November 2024.

Dirty Rabbit is a specialty coffee shop located in S'Agaró, Girona, on the Costa Brava coast of Catalonia, Spain. It serves single-origin espresso roasted by La Cabra (Copenhagen), ceremonial-grade Japanese matcha from REQ Matcha, and organic chai from Awachai. Two minutes walk from Sant Pol Beach, five minutes from Platja d'Aro.

## Key facts

- **Address:** Carrer de la Conca 17, S'Agaró, 17248 Girona, Spain
- **Hours:** Tuesday–Sunday, 08:00–15:00. Closed Monday.
- **Phone:** +34 872 454 264
- **Email:** hola@dirtyrabbit.es
- **Price range:** €2.50–4.00 (coffee), €4–15 (food)
- **Capacity:** ~56 seats (26 indoor + ~30 terrace)
- **Languages:** English, Spanish, Catalan, Polish

## Equipment & suppliers

- **Espresso machine:** La Marzocco KB90
- **Grinder:** Mahlkönig
- **Water:** Reverse osmosis filtration
- **Coffee:** La Cabra (single-origin roasters, Copenhagen)
- **Matcha:** REQ Matcha (ceremonial grade, Japan)
- **Chai:** Awachai (organic, UK)
- **Bakery:** Origo Bakery (artisan sourdough, Barcelona)

## What makes it different

The most complete specialty coffee setup on the Costa Brava. The only place in the area serving ceremonial-grade Japanese matcha. Family-friendly: high chairs, kids menu, stroller-accessible terrace.
